crime: Every night at nine, {WITCH_NAME} used her Magic to burst fireworks over the courtyard, and every night one girl leaned on the upper railing with a sketchbook, drawing the prisoners' upturned faces. She was the one who saw what the fireworks did to them.

One evening at half past eight, the girl held out her sketchbook to {WITCH_NAME} at the railing, open to a finale she had drawn: swallows, then a rain of gold. "I watched their faces," she said. "This is what they love. Do it at the end."
Back in primary school, a teacher had given {WITCH_NAME} a card with a dot on it, marking the moment to shout the class cheer. She had always shouted a beat after everyone else, into the quiet.

As soon as the sketchbook was in her hands, {WITCH_NAME} pressed the girl's throat down onto the iron rail until she stopped moving. Then she laid the girl behind the rail with the sketchbook open to the finale and a pencil in her hand.
At a quarter past nine, {WITCH_NAME} stood among the girls at the fountain and closed the show with swallows and a rain of gold. Around her, the girls gasped as one.
Afterward, as the girls did after every show, a prisoner ran up to the railing to see that night's sketch and found the girl dead behind the rail.

In the trial court, the prisoners ruled that the girl had been killed after sketching the finale, while {WITCH_NAME} stood among them at the fountain. Then a prisoner turned back through the sketchbook. Every page showed the girls' faces lit from above. The finale page had no faces at all. The prisoners understood: the page had not been sketched from the fireworks; the fireworks had been copied from the page, drawn before the show and seen by no one but {WITCH_NAME}.
fields.epitaph: For once she came in right on the beat, and the cue was a dead girl's.
execution: On the execution stand, a great iron firework shell rises on a pole above a ring of iron girls. She is chained upright at the center, her face turned up. The shell blooms open and rains its iron petals straight down onto her. All around, the iron girls open their mouths in one gasp at the bloom. Not one face turns to her. She hangs still in her chains beneath the empty shell, and the iron faces stay turned up to the sky.

magic.name: Daydream Fireworks
magic.text: She bursts fireworks of pure light in the air around her, in any shape and color she imagines.
